sections.h2: Where Alachua interiors wear out first
body: The rooms that bring people to us are predictable. Hallways where the walls no longer wipe clean. A bathroom ceiling spotted from summer humidity. A family room with big windows where afternoon light shows every roller mark and patch. Interior painting in Alachua, FL is mostly about getting those rooms right, and it's done by our own crew instead of a subcontractor.

Many homes in Savannah Station, Heritage Oaks, and the larger properties on the north end have open floor plans and tall walls. That means we spend more time on ladders and planning where one color ends and the next begins. We plan those transitions before any color goes on the wall.

sections.h2: Choosing a sheen for each room
body: Sheen matters about as much as color. We use a washable satin in kitchens, baths, hallways, and kids' rooms, where walls get touched and scrubbed. Matte or eggshell works best in rooms with lots of glass, because a lower sheen hides small surface flaws that raking light would show. For doors, trim, and railings we use a waterborne urethane enamel, since those surfaces take the most hands and bumps. The full breakdown is in our article on choosing the right finish for any room.

New paint over a bad wall just highlights the problem. Before priming, we fix nail pops, fill dents, tape and mud cracked corners, and match the existing texture. Bubbling or blistering paint usually means moisture or a bonding problem. We find the cause before painting over it, and our post on fixing bubbling drywall paint walks through the usual culprits. Larger repairs are covered by our drywall repair service and listed as their own line item.

sections.h2: Timing and living around the work
body: One room usually takes one day. A whole-home interior runs three days to two weeks. Interior painting works in any season, so summer, when exteriors are harder to schedule, is a good time for it. You don't need to leave. We move and cover furniture, work one room at a time, and low-VOC products keep the smell down in bedrooms.

Still choosing colors? Book an in-home color session in Alachua so you can see full-size drawdowns on your own walls first. For the bigger picture, our interior painting overview covers the whole process.

faqs.q: How long does it take to paint one room?
faqs.a: Usually one day, including prep and two coats. Rooms with heavy drywall repair or a dramatic color change may need a little longer, and the estimate will say so.

faqs.q: Do you paint ceilings and trim along with the walls?
faqs.a: Yes. Ceilings, trim, doors, and baseboards can all go on the same estimate, each with its own product and sheen.

faqs.q: Can you match a color I already have?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match from a paint chip, a cabinet door, or a leftover can, and paint full-size drawdowns so you can check the match on the wall.
Yes. Low-VOC and eco-conscious options are available for any room, which is especially helpful for nurseries and bedrooms.
